name: cheduecoglioni
summary: A simple reversal scalping EA that alternates between buy and sell positions. After a position is closed by take-profit or stop-loss, it immediately opens a new position in the opposite direction. It uses fixed lot sizing with configurable take-profit and stop-loss in pips.
summary_zh: 一个简单的反转剥头皮EA，在买入和卖出仓位之间交替交易。当一个仓位被止盈或止损平仓后，立即在相反方向开立新仓位。使用固定手数，可配置点数止盈和止损。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于反转逻辑的持续交易：每当一笔交易被平仓后，立即在相反方向开仓，形成买卖交替的循环。入场条件完全依赖于上一笔交易的平仓方向——如果是买入平仓（DEAL_ENTRY_OUT + DEAL_TYPE_BUY），则下一笔开卖出；如果是卖出平仓，则下一笔开买入。出场条件仅依靠固定点数的止盈和止损，没有任何技术指标辅助判断。仓位管理采用固定手数（InpLots=0.1），不做任何加仓或减仓操作。资金管理方面存在严重缺陷，没有最大持仓限制、没有亏损累计控制、没有资金比例计算，仅依赖CheckVolume检查保证金是否充足。策略本质上是一个永远在场的反转系统，无论市场趋势如何都会持续交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is a persistent reversal-based trading loop: whenever a position is closed, a new position is immediately opened in the opposite direction, creating a continuous buy-sell alternation. Entry conditions rely entirely on the direction of the previous closed trade — if a buy position is closed out (DEAL_ENTRY_OUT + DEAL_TYPE_BUY), the next trade opens a sell, and vice versa. Exit conditions use only fixed pip-based take-profit and stop-loss values with no technical indicator confirmation whatsoever. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (InpLots=0.1) with no scaling, martingale, or proportional sizing logic. Money management is severely lacking — there is no maximum position limit, no cumulative loss control, no percentage-of-equity sizing, relying solely on CTrade.CheckVolume to verify margin sufficiency. The strategy is essentially an always-in-market reversal system that trades continuously regardless of market trend or conditions.
pros: 策略逻辑极其简单，代码易于理解和维护
使用标准库CTrade和CSymbolInfo，交易执行较为规范
包含3/5位小数点的点值调整，适应不同报价精度
交易前通过CheckVolume检查保证金充足性，避免因资金不足导致的订单失败
pros_en: Extremely simple strategy logic, code is easy to understand and maintain
Uses standard MQL5 Trade library classes (CTrade, CSymbolInfo) for proper trade execution
Includes point value adjustment for 3/5 digit brokers, handling different quote precisions correctly
Checks margin sufficiency via CheckVolume before placing orders, avoiding insufficient-fund errors
cons: 完全没有技术指标或市场分析，纯粹依赖反转逻辑盲目交易
没有点差过滤，剥头皮策略在高点差环境下极易亏损
止损和止盈仅10点，点差很容易超过止盈目标导致持续亏损
没有最大回撤控制或连续亏损限制，可能在剧烈行情中持续亏损
没有新K线检查，每个tick都可能触发交易逻辑导致重复下单风险
cons_en: No technical indicators or market analysis whatsoever — trades blindly based on pure reversal logic
No spread filter, which is critical for a scalping strategy that can easily lose money in high-spread conditions
Stop-loss and take-profit of only 10 pips mean spread can easily exceed the profit target, leading to consistent losses
No maximum drawdown control or consecutive loss limit, risking sustained losses during volatile markets
No new bar check, so trade logic could trigger on every tick creating risk of duplicate orders
improvements: 添加技术指标过滤（如均线趋势方向、RSI超买超卖），避免逆势交易
增加点差过滤和最大回撤控制，在不利市场条件下暂停交易
添加新K线检查机制，防止在同一根K线上重复开仓
improvements_en: Add technical indicator filters (e.g., MA trend direction, RSI overbought/oversold) to avoid trading against the trend
Add spread filter and maximum drawdown control to pause trading under unfavorable market conditions
Add new bar check mechanism to prevent duplicate order placement on the same candle

risk_points: 剥头皮策略无点差过滤，高点差环境下止盈10点极易被点差吞噬
无连续亏损限制和最大回撤保护，可能在剧烈行情中持续亏损
无新K线检查，存在同一tick重复下单的风险
始终在场策略意味着无论市场状况如何都持续持仓，缺乏市场环境判断
risk_points_en: Scalping strategy without spread filter — 10-pip TP is easily consumed by spread in high-spread environments
No consecutive loss limit or max drawdown protection, risking sustained losses during volatile conditions
No new bar check creates risk of duplicate order placement on the same tick
Always-in-market strategy means positions are held regardless of market conditions, lacking market environment judgment
